verdicts.reason: I checked the current YAML: F-5-T1's only incoming move is from F-2-T1, and nothing leads to F-2-T1, so that part of the claim is true. It is already recorded in verified-by-review #5 and in findings none-rest#7, f2#2 and missing#14. The new part of the claim, that a consulate can issue F-5-T1 to the family with no time in Korea, rests only on the section heading '사증발급·자격변경' copied into visadocs. That same document list asks for 체류지 입증서류 (proof of residence in Korea), and F-5-T1's own 'how' requires 3 years on F-2-T1 (2 if the family joins after the principal gets F-5-T). The proposed needs {spouse: f5} would also block minor children. The 2026 manual text was out of reach: the web search budget was used up and WebFetch failed with a DNS error, so the conditions for a visa issued abroad are unconfirmed.
verdicts.correctedFix:
Do NOT add NONE -> F-5-T1. Make F-5-T1 reachable through F-2-T1 instead:
# data/visamap.yaml
  NONE:
    next:
    - F-2-T1        # moves out of NONE are always from abroad
  F-3:
    next:
    - F-2-T1        # in-Korea change when the principal moves to F-2-T
# F-2-T1 keeps needs [{spouse: foreigner}, {parent: foreigner}].
# data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-2-T1: add `change:` and `abroad:` keys with the same source and docs as its existing `extend:` list. Its source heading is '사증발급·체류자격 변경·체류기간 연장', so it covers all three. That gives both new moves a document list.
Add NONE -> F-5-T1 only after reading the F-5-T1 conditions in 사증발급 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 39 › Ⅳ. If you do add it, use needs: [{spouse: f5}, {parent: f5}] and make F-5-T1's 'how' agree with it.
verdicts.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 39. 톱티어(Top-Tier) 비자 › Ⅳ. 동반 가족 등 (F-2-T1 and F-5-T1 sections, as copied into data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-2-T1 and F-5-T1); 사증발급 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 39 › Ⅳ (F-5-T1 abroad list)
verdicts.quote: 동반가족(배우자·미성년자녀)의 영주 (F-5-T1) › 사증발급·자격변경 › (제출서류): … 체류지 입증서류 … 주 자격자의 여권 사본 및 외국인등록증; □ 톱티어 거주 동반가족(배우자·미성년자녀) › 사증발급·체류자격 변경·체류기간 연장

verdicts.reason: The claim holds on the current repo. Every E-7 sub-code except E-7-4R and the unreachable E-7-Y offers F-5-1. Decree table 1-3 item 1 counts any status from D-7 to E-7, and E-7-4R is a 특정활동(E-7) sub-code. The proposed fix is out of date, though: the engine now gives E-7-4 -> F-5-1 needs {edu: 3, stay: {years: 5, in: permanentWork}}, and a move's own needs replace the visa's. A move with needs {edu: 3} alone would therefore drop the 5-year stay check that all other E-7 moves keep. With the corrected entry, a node simulation gives: blocked for edu 1, open for edu 3 or unknown.
verdicts.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의3 영주(F-5) 제1호 (law.go.kr, 대통령령 current text as quoted in visa-map-audit/findings.md e7-main#2)
verdicts.quote: 대한민국 「민법」에 따른 성년으로서 별표 1의2 중 10. 주재(D-7)부터 20. 특정활동(E-7)까지의 체류자격이나 별표 1의2 중 24. 거주(F-2) 체류자격으로 5년 이상 대한민국에 체류하고 있는 사람

verdicts.reason: The current H-2 next list is [F-4, F-5-14, E-7-4, E-7-4R], and F-5-7's only incoming move is from F-4. Decree table 1-3 item 5 sets no prior-status condition. The manual's F-5-7 document list (in data/visadocs.yaml) asks for '외국인등록증(거소신고증)', so it accepts an alien registration card such as an H-2 holder's, not only the F-4 residence card. F-5-7 has a 'change' document list, so an in-Korea move fits. A node simulation shows H-2 -> F-5-7 open by default and blocked only for korean:false.

verdicts.reason: F-5-12 (특별공로자) is a real sub-code under decree table 1-3 item 10, it has no node in the map, and the map's F-5-28 is the separate 특별기여자 code. So the claim holds. The fix does not. The only criterion is the Minister's discretion, which no engine fact can express, so the new node would have no gate. Wired from six work statuses, it would show as OPEN to every reader there, which makes the map's 'everything is open' problem worse (verified-by-review #7/#8). It also has no KIS document list (not in visadocs), so the in-Korea moves would point at a visa with no 'change' list.
verdicts.correctedFix: Do not add an F-5-12 node or any moves to it. Optional: add one sentence to F-5-11's how.en: 'Separately, F-5-12 is granted only to people the Minister of Justice recognises as having special merit to Korea, so the map does not offer it as a step.' The ru, uz and uz-cyrl versions still need to be translated.
verdicts.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의3 영주(F-5) 제10호; data/visadocs.yaml (no F-5-12 target; F-5-28 = 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 18. 특별기여자[F-5-28])
verdicts.quote: 대한민국에 특별한 공로가 있다고 법무부장관이 인정하는 사람

verdicts.reason: F-5-4's how.en still reads '2+ years on F-2-3 after the family member has held F-5 for 2+ years'. Decree table 1-3 item 2 puts the 2-year period on the applicant's own stay in Korea and sets no waiting period for the principal's F-5. The manual's F-5-4 document list asks for proof of the family relationship and a birth certificate, but nothing that would prove when the principal got F-5. If the 2 years must be on F-2-3, the extra clause is redundant; if any stay counts, it is wrong. Either way the proposed wording is right. The repo's current gate, needs {stay: {years: 2, in: [F-2-3]}}, can stay: F-5-4's only incoming move is from F-2-3, so it gives 'later' or 'maybe' and never blocks.
verdicts.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의3 영주(F-5) 제2호; 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 3. 일반 영주자의 배우자 또는 미성년 자녀〔F-5-4〕 › 다. 제출서류 (data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-5-4.change)

verdicts.reason: The finding offers no source, and none could be checked here (web search budget used up, WebFetch DNS failure). The circumstantial case for 'invented' is weak. (1) A regional variant would sit under decree table 1-3 item 4, the F-4 status (F-4-R is an F-4 sub-code), so no separate 지역특화 item is expected. (2) The real codes F-5-14, F-5-23 and F-5-27 are also missing from visadocs, so absence there proves nothing. (3) The '2 years for existing residents' rule matches the regional overseas-Korean programme's own applicant groups (existing residents, movers from elsewhere in Korea, movers from abroad; '해외전입자' in the F-4-R list). It does not come from F-5-14. Deleting the node without a source is not justified.
verdicts.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의3 영주(F-5) 제4호; 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 37. 지역특화형비자 › Ⅲ. 지역특화형 재외동포 인구감소지역 › (1) 체류자격 변경 › 2. 제출서류 (data/visadocs.yaml targets.F-4-R.change)
